2724-3557-8172.description:
Declare Brago as an attacker attacking a player who cannot block it.
When Brago deals combat damage to a player, it triggers, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

1409-3188-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

1636-2527-3143-4247.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-3143-4247.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

2231-4871-5220-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-4871-5220-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
2231-4871-5220-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

147-719-7884.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Sygg's Command
147-719-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Sygg's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Sygg's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-719-7884.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

225-280-751-3314.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-280-751-3314.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

997-1263-4871-7316.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1298-1618-2440-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Ovika triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token for each trigger.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2713-6705-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Zirda, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-2713-6705-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

546-4499-4613-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least five tapped lands on the battlefield.
546-4499-4613-7232.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Ignition Team. Ignition Team enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Ignition Team using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3263-7259.description: Cast Anzrag's Rampage by paying {5}, destroying all permanents you don't control, as they're all artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.

2921-4200-4681.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-4359-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4359-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-5310-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1978-4324-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Workshop Elders.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-4324-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

6747-6867-6869.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
6747-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

4593-4659-6291-6823.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
When the Phyrexian Mites enter the battlefield, Aunt May triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-6291-6823.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mites.

5078-5901-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-5901-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Artist's Talent's first ability triggers. Choose not to discard a card.
Repeat

333-2730-6797.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2730-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

527-4824-6287.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Soliton and Selvala are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
527-4824-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {5}{G}{U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

222-527-955-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-955-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-3771-5258-5618-5686.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least X +1/+1 counters on it.
586-3771-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {3}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2608-4499-4734.notablePrerequisites: Cradle Clearcutter does not have summoning sickness.
2608-4499-4734.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.

2719-4050-5756.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, adding one mana of any color.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2653-5226-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
2653-5226-5720-5721.description:
Activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Nissa's trigger.

883-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
883-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

1235-1296-2743.description:
Cast Finale of Promise by paying {10}{R}{R}, causing you to cast Twinflame from your graveyard without paying its mana cost and copying it twice, with all spells targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Twinflames, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers, and Twinflame triggers three times.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

751-3314-3470-3756.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1124-1945-2034-4356.description:
Activate Chandra's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Elementals, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Ral Zarek's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

738-3370-3652-4050.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Phyrexian Altar, adding one mana of any color.
Butcher of Malakir triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
